messages:
ashley.li: Hey, seeing a weird flicker where admin panel shows rows from the previous org when I quick-switch. Not scrolled, actual data bleed. repro: switch org A -> org B using topbar, open run list, then hit cmd+k and switch back. Happens ~1/3 tries.
priya: whoa. any console logs? header like x-org-id being wrong?
ashley.li: adding console network trace: request to /api/runs has header `x-workspace-id: 1312` but UI shows rows from 4209. snapshot attached (screenshot).
tim_h: could be stale client cache + route affinity on edge. Our gateway sticky-cookie sometimes routes to previously cached frontend seat which has cached prefetch for 4209.
ben_k: we don't set any tenant cookie in frontend, only `console-session`. If gateway does affinity by cookie, it shouldn't change payload. Are you sure backend returned mixed-org rows?
ashley.li: backend response body includes rows with workspace_id 4209. server logs show handler saw workspace_id 1312 but a later db query used workspace 4209. suspicious.
priya: sounds like server-side request scoping bug. Maybe a pool connection reused a tenant-prefixed context in async handler. We had similar in /api/search where ctx.tenant isn't cleared before async prefetch.
ben_k: that rings a bell. In route-middleware we set `res.locals.tenant` then await some async hooks. If any background promise mutates global scope, leak.
priya: can you paste the middleware snippet?
ashley.li: ```js
app.use((req,res,next)=>{
  req.tenant = req.headers['x-workspace-id']
  hooks.run('prefetch', req).then(()=>next())
})
```
priya: oof, `.then(()=>next())` without try/catch could allow prefetch to run in parallel and mutate shared caches. Should `await hooks.run(...)` or use per-request cache keyed by req.id.
tim_h: agreed. quick fix: mark prefetch async but ensure it clones ctx: `const ctx = {...req}; hooks.run(ctx)` or change middleware to `await hooks.run(req)` so it's sequential.
ben_k: also add telemetry tags: make sure trace spans include `tenant_id` at span start. Our telemetry shows mixed `tenant_id` for same request id which will help debugging.
ashley.li: assigning to @priya to draft a patch, canary to 1% on staging then prod. priority P0? This leaks cross-org data.
priya: on it. I'll open a PR with fix + unit to ensure per-request cache isolation. will include migration for prefetch API to be explicit about ctx.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging-canary at 2026-03-21T03:00Z -> notify #eng-oncall
ashley.li: thanks. also let's add a temporary guard: if response contains rows with conflicting workspace_ids, log and drop response and return 500 until patch lands. blunt but safe.
priya: ACK. I'll add the guard and playbook steps for SOC.
